scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run start:dev -w apps/api"
scripts.start:local: concurrently -n web,api -c magenta,cyan "npm run start -w apps/web" "npm run start:prod -w apps/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
